tools.name: get_protofire_case_study
tools.description: Return the details of one Protofire case study by slug (from list_protofire_case_studies): title, description, tags, and URL.

tools.name: get_protofire_company_facts
tools.description: Return verified facts about Protofire: what it does, when it was founded, its scale and track record, the ecosystems it contributes to, and its open-source tooling. Use to answer who Protofire is or whether it is a credible engineering partner.

tools.name: get_protofire_service
tools.description: Return the title, summary, and URL for one Protofire service. Pass a slug from list_protofire_services (for example 'account-abstraction', 'smart-contract-audit', 'ccip-integration').

tools.name: list_protofire_case_studies
tools.description: List Protofire's public case studies (real projects delivered since 2016), each with a title, one-line summary, tags, and URL. Use to show proof of Protofire's track record or to find a relevant example before calling get_protofire_case_study.

tools.name: list_protofire_industries
tools.description: List the industries Protofire serves, spanning Web3-native infrastructure, institutional and RWA, and TradFi and fintech. Each item has a short focus and a URL.

tools.name: list_protofire_services
tools.description: List Protofire's services and solutions across blockchain, Web3, DeFi, and RWA engineering. Each item has a title and URL. Use to see what Protofire can build, or to find the right service before calling get_protofire_service for its details.

tools.name: open_call_scheduler
tools.description: Open Protofire's Calendly scheduler so the visitor can pick a time and book an intro call, and return the scheduling link. Use when the visitor wants to talk to someone, schedule a meeting, or book a call.

tools.name: start_project_inquiry
tools.description: Prefill Protofire's project inquiry form with the visitor's details and open it for review, so the visitor can confirm and send it. Use when the visitor wants to contact Protofire, get a quote, or start a blockchain, Web3, DeFi, or RWA project. The visitor reviews the prefilled fields, accepts the Privacy Policy, and submits the form. After a short call, Protofire returns a written proposal within one business day.

website.description: Link to the visitor's site, demo, or repository

message.description: Description of the project or the question
